| description = Telkorenar is found in the west wing and offers quests to those allied with the Claws of Veeshan. 

Casts [[Lava Breath]], the same dispelling fire AOE DD that [[Lord Nagafen]] casts.

=== Strategy ===

Fire and dragonsbane DD spells the best? Cannot be slowed?

Healing strategy: 2 clerics on 10second cheal cycles, 2 clerics on DL, rest rotate in when originals OoM.
